summary: {person} signs the amended county budget with the board chair there to answer for it.
realLife: Milwaukee County Executive David Crowley accepted the board’s 2026 budget without vetoes after supervisors changed his recommendation.
gates: The executive has received an amended budget awaiting action.
weights: A contentious amendment makes the signature more consequential.
inGame: needs: passed budget, amendments, executive action and date.

turns.what: The executive explains why the whole budget still earned a signature.
turns.pulledBy: A supervisor asks about an amendment the executive opposed.
turns.writesBack: Link the explanation to the signed version.

turns.what: Each points to a different stage of the bill.
turns.pulledBy: The chair and executive disagree over who deserves credit.
turns.writesBack: Keep proposal and adoption dates in the account.
